title: HyperOS 3 Hidden Settings 3 Tweaks That Change Everything
blurb: Three HyperOS 3 settings most people never find — animation speed, back tap shortcuts and battery optimization.
video_description:
Three HyperOS 3 settings most people never find — animation speed, back tap shortcuts and battery optimization. Small changes, big difference in how the phone feels.

HyperOS is packed with things sitting behind menus nobody opens. These three are the ones I'd enable on any device running it, because they change the everyday feel instead of adding gimmicks.

The first is animation speed. Drop the three scale values to 0.5x and the whole UI feels instantly faster, without any performance trickery. It's just the animation timing being honest about how quick the hardware actually is.

The second is back tap. Double or triple tap the back of your phone to grab a screenshot, open the camera or flip on the torch. Once you start using it, going back feels slow.

The third is battery optimization. HyperOS has a battery checkup that suggests real changes based on how you use the phone, plus per-app battery saver on top of that.

🎯 What It Does
• Speeds up the whole UI by shortening animation scales
• Adds a back tap gesture for quick actions
• Surfaces battery suggestions based on your own usage

💡 Best Part
• The animation tweak is the fastest win. Thirty seconds, and the phone feels new.
• Back tap saves a swipe every time you want a screenshot.
• Battery checkup points at apps that are quietly draining you.

🚫 What It Doesn't Do
• It won't unlock features your hardware doesn't have.
• Back tap needs a case that isn't so thick it swallows the taps.
• Battery suggestions help, but heavy apps still cost battery.
